ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (central black region) to high-intensity (lateral light-gray lobes) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black pigmentation block extending from the peduncle in a 'V' shape towards the trailing edge. High-frequency pixel mottling and splashing occur at the transition zones between the black center and the light-gray/white lateral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with a calculated base angle of approximately 25 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent serrations, peaks, and valleys. Significant jaggedness concentrated in the medial regions flanking the notch; distal tips exhibit irregular, chunky textures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex trajectory from the notch to the mid-lobe, straightening slightly toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, circular/semi-circular pixel groups at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear disruptions (white/gray on black background) crossing the central and inner-lobe regions, consistent with rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) distributed across the central pigmentation and lobe transitions; irregular, non-linear tissue loss or calcification on the distal trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark-pixel focal spots isolated within the high-intensity regions of the outer lobes, particularly a cluster of 5-7 spots on the right distal lobe.
